channel.title: Canola Council of Canada News Monitor
channel.description: Recent news and press releases from the Canola Council of Canada and industry partners.

item.title: Canola Industry Watches CUSMA Talks
item.description: With 78% of Canada's canola oil exports heading to the United States in 2025, Canadian growers and the Canola Council of Canada are closely monitoring the upcoming review of the Canada-U.S.-Mexico Agreement (CUSMA).

item.title: Final Determination: China Reduces Canola Tariffs
item.description: According to a news release from the Canola Council of Canada, China's Ministry of Commerce finalized a reduced 5.9% anti-dumping duty on Canadian canola seed imports and temporarily removed the 100% tariff on canola meal for the remainder of 2026.

item.title: Farmer Funding to Drive Innovation under Canola Agronomic Research Program
item.description: Administered by the Canola Council of Canada, the CARP initiative announced a $4 million investment across 11 new research projects aimed at advancing canola productivity and mitigating production threats like pests and drought.

item.title: Canola Industry Welcomes 45Z Clean Fuel Ruling in U.S.
item.description: The Canola Council of Canada applauded new U.S. guidance for the 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit, which confirms fuel made from Canadian canola as an approved pathway without indirect land-use penalties.

item.title: Farm Groups Applaud New Preliminary Agreement on Tariffs
item.description: The Canola Council of Canada and the Canadian Canola Growers Association welcomed a preliminary agreement bringing significant relief, estimating tariffs on seed drops to 15% from the previous 85%.
